name: Almadasuchus
sum: Almadasuchus is a crocodylomorph from the early Late Jurassic Cañadón Calcáreo Formation of Patagonia, Argentina.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Puesto Almada Member.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Pol et al. 2013
